Leah M.: hey team, Leah here (joined platform last month). I'm on the oncall starting next Tue but can't access /runbooks/index.md (403) and PD shows 'not eligible'. Who should I ping for runbook perms + schedule add? :wave:

Diego P.: welcome! file oncall-access (https://wiki.internal/access-requests -> oncall-runbooks + oncall-eligibility) and paste the ticket id. I'll handle the PD add once Okta sync finishes. We shadow 2x 90m then 1 supervised solo.

Leah M.: filed PRR-7651 for runbook and OKTA-9102 for PD. Also need bastion SSH; getting timeout to jumphost.

SREBot: Okta sync started for "Leah M." -> group "platform-oncall" (audit: b9c4). Bastion ACL: request queued.

Diego P.: I can open a 24h SSH window for you. Jesse will confirm bastion. Once you're in PD run a test page: ```pd trigger --user "leah.m@redwood.com" --note "oncall test"``` Confirm mobile + email.

R&D Oncall Trainer: Shadow slots: Mon 15:00-16:30 UTC, Wed 10:00-11:30 UTC. Sim instructions: join #eng-oncall-sim and run `sre-sim start --profile platform --user leahm`. During shadow follow incident-lifecycle.md strictly, open a timeline entry on first alert, and escalate to shadow by reply-all if uncertain.

Leah M.: got runbook email and PD push. Bastion works after Jesse added my key. Thanks all! One Q: can I PR small runbook fixes during probation?

Diego P.: yes, PRs allowed. For probation we require runbook-owner + SRE reviewer before merge. Small typos usually get 1-2 day turnaround. No direct pushes to main.

Leah M.: great, accepted the Wed slot. Appreciate the quick help :thumbsup:
